shayaris.textHinglish:
Lambi hai manzil paas hai kinara,
Kyun nahi aata ab phone tumhara,
Bhool gaye naam ya number hamara,
Ya mil gaya koi dost humse bhi pyara.

Chiraagon mein itna noor na hota,
Toh tanha dil majboor na hota,
Hum aapse milne zaroor aate,
Agar aapka ghar itna door na hota.

Har insaan ka dil bura nahi hota,
Har ek insaan bura nahi hota,
Bujh jaate hain deeye kabhi tel ki kami se,
Har baar kasoor hawa ka nahi hota.

Khud ko bhi kabhi khud se milaya karo,
Jo ho tum, usi ko dil se apnaya karo,
Duniya toh kamiyaan ginti rahegi umr bhar,
Tum khud ko har haal mein gale lagaya karo.

Unhe chaahna hamari kamzori hai,
Unse keh na paana hamari majboori hai,
Woh kyun nahi samajhti hamari khamoshi ko,
Kya pyaar ka izhaar karna zaroori hai.

Khud par thoda yakeen rakhna,
Har mod pe khud ka saath rakhna,
Duniya chahe der se samjhe tumhe,
Tum bas apne yeh khwaabon ko zinda rakhna.

Pal pal tadpe jis pal ke liye,
Woh pal bhi aaya kuch pal ke liye,
Socha us pal ko rok loon har pal ke liye,
Par woh pal bhi thehra kuch pal ke liye.

Chup rehte rehte waqt guzar jaayega,
Marne ke baad kaun kisi ko yaad aayega,
Jee lo mere saath yeh pal aye mere dost,
Na jaane kab yeh chehra kafan mein chhup jaayega.

Teri tarah har kisi ko aankhon ke noor nahi milte,
Dost toh sab ko mil jaate hain,
Lekin tere jaise kohinoor nahi milte.

Na tum door jaana na hum door jaayenge,
Apne apne hisse ki dosti nibhayenge,
Bahut accha hoga zindagi ka yeh safar,
Tum wahan se yaad karna hum yahan se muskurayenge.

Jis din hum teri duniya se jaayenge,
Itni khushi aur pyar chhod jaayenge,
Jab bhi yaad karoge is pagal ko,
Toh hansti aankhon se bhi aansu nikal aayenge.

Har kisi ko dil se lagaya nahi jaa sakta,
Tumhari tasveer ko mere dil se mitaya nahi jaa sakta,
Mil toh jaayenge laakhon chehre is duniya mein,
Magar tum meri zindagi ka woh qissa ho
Jo kabhi bhulaya nahi jaa sakta.

Kinaaron par moti mila nahi karte,
Dard mein kabhi gila nahi karte,
Hum achhe na sahi bure hi achhe,
Par hum jaise bure bhi har kisi ko mila nahi karte.

Faaltu baithe log cheenti ka bhi
Raasta rok dete hain, bol ab kidhar jaayegi,
Aur tumhe lagta hai, tum yoon hi
Chale jaoge apni manzil tak.

Kabar par woh rone aaye hain,
Humse pyar hai yeh kehne aaye hain,
Jab zinda tha toh rulaya bohot tha,
Ab aaram se soye hain toh jagane aaye hain.

Yaadon ki hawa zakhmon ki dawa ban gayi,
Doori tumhari meri chaahat ki saza ban gayi,
Kaise bhula doon main tumhe ek pal ke liye,
Tumhari yaadein mere jeene ki wajah ban gayi.

Padhne wala bhi tera deedar karega,
Ek baar nahi sau baar padhega,
Main likhunga jab shayari tujhpe,
Meri diary ka ek ek panna bhi tujhse pyaar karega.

Woh saamne tha aur hum palke utha na sake,
Chaahte the magar paas uske jaa na sake,
Na dekh le woh apni tasveer hamari aankhon mein,
Bas yahi sochkar hum unse nazrein mila na sake.

Tum zulfein lehra ke din ko raat kiya karo,
Tum bindi laga kar khoobsurati ko maat diya karo,
Mujhe zamane se matlab nahi tum mera zamana ho,
Tum mere saamne apni hi baat kiya karo.

Har koi mera ho jaaye aisi meri taqdeer nahi,
Main woh sheesha hoon jiski koi tasveer nahi,
Dard se rishta hai mera khushiyan mujhe naseeb nahi,
Mujhe bhi koi yaad kare main itna bhi khushnaseeb nahi.

Yeh shararatein sirf aapke liye hain jaana,
Zamane ke liye toh hum shareef hain,
Aur hum yun hi aapki tareef nahi karte,
Yakeen kijiye aap kabil-e-tareef hain.

Thahar jaaoon tumhari galiyon mein
Toh mujhe dekhkar tum muskuraogi kya,
Chalo ruk bhi gaya tumhare ghar ke saamne
Toh andar bulakar chai pilaoge kya.

Chalo aaj hum izhaar karte hain,
Haan hum tumse pyar karte hain,
Tasveer dekh kar tumhari haal behaal karte hain,
Mil jaye fursat tumhein duniya ki uljhanon se,
Toh yaad kar lena hum har pal tumhare message ka intezar karte hain.

Roshni kya hui raat ko bhool gaye,
Suraj kya nikla chand ko bhool gaye,
Maana nahi hui mulaqat kuch dino se,
Aap toh hume yaad karna hi bhool gaye.

Tu na samjhe toh samjhaun kaise,
Apni chaahat ka ehsaas dilaun toh dilaun kaise,
Tu toh apni duniya mein khush hai,
Lekin mera kya haal hai tumhare bina tumhe main bataun kaise.

Mehfil bhi royegi har dil bhi royega,
Doobegi hasti meri toh zamana bhi royega,
Itna pyar baatunga is duniya mein,
Mere marne ke baad aashiq toh kya kaatil bhi royega.

Haal aisa ki baithe-baithe kho jaate hain hum,
Mehfilon mein hanste-hanste ro jaate hain hum,
Kaise bataun ki kya guzri hai is dil par,
Bas 'sab theek hai' kehkar so jaate hain hum.

Tumhein yaad rakhne ka mera andaaz thoda nirala hai,
Maine tumhe tasveeron mein nahi, shabdon mein sambhala hai,
Kabhi likh di do line ki shayari tum par,
Toh kabhi tumhari yaadon mein poora khali panna hi bhar daala hai.

Ishq usse karo jisme kamiyan bahut ho,
Yeh husn se bhare chehre itraate bahut hain,
Aur mohabbat rooh se honi chahiye,
Lafzon se jatane wale rulaate bahut hain.

Mujhse pyar karne ki bhool kar,
Mere liye apne alag usool kar,
Main jaisa bhi hoon tera hoon,
Tu meri ban mujhe qubool kar.

Pyar aur maut se darta kaun hai,
Pyar toh ho jaata hai karta kaun hai,
Hum toh kar de pyar mein jaan bhi qurban,
Par pata toh chale humse pyar karta kaun hai.

Ishaaron ko samajh jao tum mujhe jatana nahi aata,
Pyaar toh bahut hai tumse magar mujhe batana nahi aata.

Paas aakar sab door chale jaate hain,
Akele the hum akele hi reh jaate hain,
Is dil ka dard dikhayein kise,
Dawa lagane wale hi dard de jaate hain.

Maza aata hai kisi ko satane mein,
Roothe na koi toh kya maza manane mein,
Ek tere jaise dost se hi toh khushi hai varna
Rakha kya hai is zindagi aur zamane mein.

Tumko yaad rakhne mein main kya kya bhool jaata hoon,
Jo dil mein baat hai tumko batana bhool jaata hoon,
Tumhare lab ko chhoone ka irada roz karta hoon,
Nazar tumse jo mil jaaye zamana bhool jaata hoon.

Ahamiyat kya hai, tumhari bata nahi sakte,
Rishta kya hai, tumse samjha nahi sakte,
Tum mere liye itne khaas ho ki
Agar tum udaas ho toh hum muskura nahi sakte.

Shikayatein bahut thi, par maine khamosh rehna seekh liya,
Tumhari khushi ke liye, tumse hi door rehna seekh liya,
Tum masroof ho apni mehfilon mein, yeh jaante hain hum,
Isliye maine bhi ab tumhari duniya mein dastak dena chhod diya.

Meri aankhon ke saamne tera chehra ho,
Tere chehre par mera pehra ho,
Tujhe mujhse ishq ho,
Khuda kare yeh ishq samandar se bhi gehra ho.

Dekh kar aapki muskurahat, hum hosh gawa baithe,
Hum hosh mein hi aane wale the, aap phir se muskura baithe.

Jaante ho phir bhi anjaan bante ho,
Is tarah kyon mujhe pareshan karte ho,
Poochhte ho mujhe kya pasand hai,
Jawaab khud ho phir bhi sawaal karte ho.

Teri har ek muskaan par marte hain hum,
Tu poochhe bhi na haal, phir bhi tujhe hi chahte hain hum,
Kismat mein nahi tu, yeh jaante hain hum,
Phir bhi har duaaon mein, tujhe hi maangte hain hum.

Na jaane kyu aati hai yaad tumhari,
Chura le jaati hai aankhon se neend hamari,
Yahi khayal rehta hai subah shaam,
Kab hogi tumse mulaqaat hamari.

Ghar se bahar woh naqaab mein nikli,
Saari gali unki firaaq mein nikli,
Inkaar karti thi woh hamari mohabbat se,
Par hamari hi tasveer unki kitaab se nikli.

Udaas nazron mein khwaab milenge,
Kabhi kaante toh kabhi gulaab milenge,
Mere dil ki kitaab meri nazron se padh kar toh dekho,
Kahin aapki yaadein toh kahin aap milenge.

Teri yaad mein hum zamana bhool gaye,
Kisi aur ko hum apnana bhool gaye,
Mujhe tujhse mohabbat hai bataya maine saare jahaan ko,
Bas galti itni hui ki tujhe hi batana bhool gaye.

Naraz ho toh haq se jata liya karo,
Yun door rehkar na aazmaya karo,
Tumhari khamoshi se darr lagta hai,
Bas apni pyari awaaz suna diya karo.

Main akela khush hoon mujhe dard batana nahi aata,
Chhod do yeh ishq ki baatein mujhe ishq jatana nahi aata,
Kehti thi meri muskaan badi pyari lagti hai,
Itna rula kar gaye ho ab mujhe muskurana bhi nahi aata.

Kuch galtiyan hui hain mujhse naadani mein,
Main bura hoon, kuch logon ki kahani mein,
Bachpan toh rajkumar sa beeta mera,
Shayad isliye fakeer hoon jawani mein,
Yeh toh naseeb ki maar hai bujha-bujha sa hoon,
Varna main aag laga deta tha paani mein.

Nazron se jo nazron ki baat hoti hai,
Woh lafzon ki kahan aukaat hoti hai,
Kuch pal ke liye hi sahi dekh toh liya,
Bas isi ek jhalak mein poori kayenaat hoti hai.

Woh waqt woh lamhe kuch ajeeb honge,
Duniya mein hum sabse khushnaseeb honge,
Door se jab itna yaad karte hain aapko,
Kya hoga jab aap hamare kareeb honge.

Agar din likhoonga, nikal jaaogi,
Raat likhoonga, dhal jaaogi,
Sukoon likhoonga, mukar jaaogi,
Mausam likhoonga, badal jaaogi,
Hawa likhoonga, udd jaaogi,
Pahaad likhoonga, toot jaaogi,
Ped likhoonga, gir jaaogi,
Rang likhoonga, badal jaaogi,
Nadi likhoonga, beh jaaogi,
Apna likhoonga, paraya ho jaaogi,
Chalo saans likhta hoon,
Jab jaaogi humein sang le jaaogi.

Tu na samjhe toh samjhaun kaise,
Apni chaahat ka ehsaas dilau kaise,
Tu toh apni duniya mein khush hai lekin,
Mera kya haal hai tere bina bataun kaise.

Maine kaha woh ajnabee hai, dil ne kaha yeh dil ki lagi hai,
Maine kaha woh sapna hai, dil ne kaha phir bhi apna hai,
Maine kaha woh do pal ki mulaqaat hai, dil ne kaha yeh sadiyon ka saath hai,
Maine kaha woh meri bhool hai, dil ne kaha phir bhi qabool hai,
Maine kaha woh meri haar hai, dil ne kaha yahi toh pyar hai.

Bahut khoobsurat hain aankhein tumhari,
Inhein bana do kismat hamari,
Nahi chahiye zamane ki khushiyan,
Agar mil jaaye mohabbat tumhari.

Tere deedar ki talab mein hum fakeer ho gaye,
Teri ek muskaan pe na jaane kitne heer ho gaye,
Tune toh bas yun hi palke jhuka kar uthayi thi,
Aur hum bina lade hi tere ishq ke mareez ho gaye.

Nazar lag jaati hai jataya na kar,
Ishq ek raaz hai bataya na kar,
Laakh samjhaya shak karta hai zamana,
Jab tu paas se guzre toh muskuraya na kar.

Hum aapki har cheez se pyaar kar lenge,
Aapki har baat par aitbaar kar lenge,
Bas ek baar keh do ki tum sirf mere ho,
Hum zindagi bhar aapka intezaar kar lenge.

Tujhe dekhne ko yeh dil tarasta hai,
Ek tere hi intezaar mein yeh dil tadapta hai,
Kaise samjhaun apne is nadaan dil ko,
Jo mera hokar bhi sirf tere liye dhadakta hai.

Itni acchi kyu lagne lagi ho,
Itna accha koi kaise ho sakta hai,
Tum chaand jaise toh bilkul nahi,
Haan chaand tumhare jaisa ho sakta hai.

Teri aankhon ke saamne yeh shehar kaun dekhega,
Tu dariya si hai, yeh lehar kaun dekhega,
Tu khoobsurat se bhi zyada khoobsurat hai,
Tujhe dekhne ke baad tajmahal kaun dekhega.

Tumhari aankhon mein dekha maine sacchi lagti ho,
Apni zulfein khol kar rakha karo acchi lagti ho.

Aata nahi tha humein iqraar karna,
Na jaane kaise seekh gaye pyaar karna,
Do pal bhi na rukte the kisi ke liye,
Na jaane kaise seekh gaye intezaar karna.

Tum jab kahoge, hum tab milenge,
Lekin ek shart par,
Na ghadi tum pehnoge, na waqt hum dekhenge.

Aankhon se sawaal poochna kisne sikhaya hai aapko,
Muskura ke maar dena kisne sikhaya hai aapko,
Dil toh karta hai aapko baith kar dekhta rahoon,
Mere khuda ne itna pyara banaya hai aapko.

Ishq hai toh jataya kar, main pasand hoon toh bataya kar,
Yoon na dekha kar meri tasveer ko,
Agar mujhe paana hai toh saamne se mujhe bataya kar.

Mil jaaye sab toh fariyaad kiski karoge,
Mulaqaat agar roz hogi toh yaad kise karoge.

Main tumse mohabbat karna tab chhodunga jab,
30 February aayegi,
Jab battery 101% ho jaayegi,
Jab Tom Jerry ko kha jaayega,
Jab nakli phool murjha jaayenge,
Ya jab meri rooh mere jism se nikal jaayegi.

Kuch saalon ke baad na jaane kya samaa hoga,
Pata nahi kaun sa dost kahan hoga,
Phir milna hoga toh milenge yaadon mein,
Jaise sookhe gulaab milte hain kitaabon mein.

Woh saamne tha aur hum palke utha na sake,
Chaahte the magar paas unke jaa na sake,
Na dekh le woh apni tasveer hamari aankhon mein,
Bas yahi sochkar hum unse nazrein mila na sake.

Ishq hai toh chhupati kyu ho,
Mujhe dekh kar muskurati kyu ho,
Keh do ek baar dil ki baatein humse,
Varna aankhon se pyaar jatati kyu ho.

Dil mein base ho aap, zara khayal rakhna,
Waqt mil jaaye toh zara yaad karna,
Humein toh aadat hai aapko yaad karne ki,
Aapko bura lage toh maaf karna.

Tum hanskar poochhti ho - 'Main chhod doon toh kya karoge?'
Kaise kahoon... Tum bin main khud ko hi kahan paaoonga.
Tum phool nahi, meri khushboo ho - tum bin main mehkoon kaise,
Tum chaand nahi, meri raat ho - tum bin main chamkoon kaise.
Tumhein khone ka khauf isliye nahi ki tum meri ho,
Balki isliye... Ki meri duniya hi tumse poori hai.

Har kisi ko safai dena zaroori nahi,
Har kisi ko sach batana zaroori nahi.
Jo dil se samjhega, woh khamoshi bhi padh lega,
Aur jo galat samjhe, woh lafzon mein bhi galti dhoond lega.

Baat ko samjh mittarr khush rehna ek art hai
Aur hum science ke student hain:)
(Aur science wale khush nahi rehte)

Kabhi tumhe poora likhu, kabhi adhoora likhu,
Main raaton mein baith kar tumhe savera likhu,
Main jab bhi likhu, bas itna likhu,
Mujhe tera aur tujhe mera likhu.

Dosti ko bade pyaar se nibhayenge,
Koshish rahegi tujhe na satayenge,
Kabhi pasand na aaye mera saath to bata dena,
Gin bhi naa paaoge itne thappad lagayenge.

Garm dopahar ki thandi shaam ho tum,
Mere dil ka sukoon, mere dil ka aaram ho tum,
Tum ho to sab kuch hai zindagi mein,
Meri khushiyon ka doosra naam ho tum.

Tamanna ho milne ki to band aankhon mein bhi nazar aayenge,
Mehsoos karne ki to koshish kijiye, door hote hue bhi paas nazar aayenge.

Kaash kahin khushiyon ki dukaan hoti,
Us dukaan mein meri jaan pehchan hoti,
Khareed leta main saari khushiyan tumhare liye,
Chaahe uski keemat meri jaan kyun na hoti.

Kaash tum poocho mujhse ke kya chahiye,
Main pakdun haath tera aur kahoon bas tera saath chahiye,
Log dhoondte honge jannat aasmaano mein,
Mujhe toh teri in aankhon mein poori qaaynaat chahiye.

Tu palat kar aa to sahi,
Ek baar nazar mila to sahi,
Main to janaaze se bhi uth jaaunga,
Tu aawaaz laga to sahi.

Ret par naam kabhi likhte nahi,
Ret par naam kabhi tikte nahi,
Log kehte hain ki hum patthar dil hain,
Lekin patthar par likhe naam kabhi mitte nahi.

Kashti hai puraani, magar dariya badal gaya,
Meri talaash ka bhi nazariya badal gaya,
Na shakal badli na hi badla mera kirdaar,
Bas logon ke dekhne ka nazariya badal gaya.

Dil pe kya guzri wo anjaan kya jaane,
Pyaar kise kehte hain wo naadaan kya jaane,
Hawa ke saath ud gaya ghar is parinde ka,
Kaise bana tha ghosla wo toofan kya jaane.

In hazaaron ki bheed mein jaana pehchana chehra ho tum,
Kisi anjaan sheher mein sukoon deta thikana ho tum,
Kisi behti kashti ko mile wo kinara ho tum,
Der tak chhayi udaasi ke baad muskuraane ka bahaana ho tum.

Bohat khaas ho tum aaj bhi,
Bas jataana chhod diya,
Yaad tumhari har roz aati hai,
Bas maine bataana chhod diya.

Log mujhse poochte hain tune usme aisa kya dekha,
Maine kaha jab use dekha uske baad kuch nahi dekha.

Kal shayari likhta likhta so gaya,
Tere khyaalon mein na jaane kahan kho gaya,
Utha to paaya khudko teri baahon mein,
Socha sapna hoga isliye phir so gaya.

Sukoon milta hai tere paas aakar jo milta kisi aur se nahi,
Ishq hai ya kuch aur nahi maloom, magar jo tujhse hai wo kisi aur se nahi.

Kisi ko sunne se zyada samajhne ki koshish kijiye,
Kyunki har koi utna keh nahi paata jitna wo mehsoos karta hai.

Phool kabhi dubara nahi khilta,
Janam kabhi dubara nahi milta,
Yoon toh mil jaate hain hazaaron par jise,
Dil se chaaho wo dubara nahi milta.

Jiski galtiyon ko bhula kar maine har baar rishta nibhaya,
Usi ne mujhe har baar faaltu hone ka ehsaas dilaya.

Pyaar aur maut se darta kaun hai,
Pyaar to ho jaata hai karta kaun hai,
Hum to kar dein pyaar mein jaan bhi qurbaan,
Par pata to chale, humse pyaar karta kaun hai.

Tum kitne bhi samajhdaar ban jaao,
Agar dil ke achhe ho to bewakoof zaroor banoge.

Shart lagi thi khushi ko ek alfaaz mein likhne ki,
Log kitaaben dhoondhte reh gaye, humne "Dost" likh diya.

Mohabbat ek khel tha taash ka,
Woh baazi maar gaye,
Hum baadshah hokar bhi,
Ek begum se haar gaye.

Jo nahi hona chahiye tha wo lagaw ho tum,
Jo kabhi na bhar sake aisa ghaav ho tum,
Jaan bhi le li aur zinda bhi chhod diya,
Khuda kasam lajawab ho tum.

Gehri thi raat lekin hum khoye nahi,
Dard bahot tha dil mein lekin hum roye nahi,
Koi nahi hamara jo pooche humse,
Jaag rahe ho kisi ke liye ya kisi ke liye soye nahi.

Jise tum aam din samajhte ho wo kisi ka khwaab hai,
Shukr guzaar raho har din, ye zindagi lajawab hai.

Mere dil ka dard kisne dekha hai,
Mujhe bas khuda ne tadapte dekha hai,
Hum tanhaai mein baithe rote hain,
Logon ne humein mehfilon mein hanste dekha hai.

Unhone jaate jaate bade guroor se kaha,
"Tum jaise to bohot milenge,"
Humne bhi muskura ke pooch liya,
"Hamare jaisa hi kyun chahiye?"

Jhoothon ke beech mein main sach bol baitha,
Woh namak ka sheher tha aur main apne zakhm khol baitha.

Har koi mohabbat mein fanaa nahi hota,
Kisi ko chaahna koi gunaah nahi hota,
Woh poochte hain tum kitna chaahte ho mujhe,
Toh woh paagal kya jaane pyaar lafzon mein bayaan nahi hota.

Kabhi kabhi gussa muskurahat se zyada khaas hota hai,
Kyunki muskurahat toh sabke liye hoti hai,
Magar gussa sirf unke liye hota hai,
Jinhein hum kabhi khona nahi chaahte.

Nafrat mat karna humse hum seh nahi paayenge,
Bas pyaar se keh dena achhe nahi lagte,
Phir kabhi nazar nahi aayenge.

Wo zindagi hi kya jisme tum saath na ho,
Wo khushiyan hi kya jisme tumhari baat na ho,
Nahi chahiye aisi zindagi jisme tum mere saath na ho,
Ro deta hai dil jab tumse meri baat na ho.

Tum door ho toh koi gham nahi,
Tujhe bhoola dein waise hum nahi,
Mulaqaat nahi hoti toh kya hua,
Tumhari yaad bhi kisi mulaqaat se kam nahi.

Kisi ne phool se poocha jab tumhe toda gaya tumhe dard hua?
Phool ne bhi khoobsurat jawaab diya:
Todne wala itna khush tha ke main dard bhool gaya.

Chhupe hain nishaan zakhmon ke, ukher dena zaroori hai kya?
Koi jee raha hai jaise taise khud ko samet kar,
Use bikher dena zaroori hai kya?

Maine palat kar bhi dekha tha,
Magar tum ja chuke the,
Issey pehle ki main kuch kehta,
Kuch log tumhe samjha chuke the.

Kaise muskuraau bina tere saath ke,
Kaise bitaau ye pal bina teri baat ke,
Bina tere to meri har khushi adhoori hai,
Meri rooh ko bhi bas teri zaroorat hai.

Bahut udaas hoon tere chup ho jaane se,
Ho sake toh baat kar kisi bahaane se,
Tu laakh khafa ho sahi lekin itna toh dekh,
Koi jeete ji mar raha hai tere door jaane se.

Kyun ro rahe ho muddat se,
Kya ishq ho gaya tha shiddat se?
Mujhe tajurba hai tabhi kehta hoon,
Maut hi achhi hai mohabbat se.

Haal kaisa hai, mijaaz kaisa hai,
Kal toh kal tha, bataao aaj kaisa hai,
Hamaare sheher mein hain log mohabbat ke dushman,
Tum bataao, tumhaare sheher mein riwaaj kaisa hai.

Kabhi kabhi yoon hi baith kar muskura leta hoon,
Tumhari yaadon se dil ko behla leta hoon,
Na jaane kab laut aao tum phir se,
Isi umeed mein khud ko samjha leta hoon.

Jise chaaha woh mila nahi, jo mila usey chaaha nahi,
Jo paaya usey maanga nahi, jo maanga woh mila nahi,
Uski khushi hai isme toh mujhe koi gila nahi,
Bas rab khush rakhe usey jo mujhe mila nahi.

Aaj aansu bhi humse pooch baithe,
Tum mujhe baar baar kyun giraate ho,
Maine kaha hum yaad kisi aur ko karte hain,
Aur chale tum aate ho.

Guzri hui zindagi ko kabhi yaad na kar,
Taqdeer mein jo nahi uski fariyaad na kar,
Jo hoga woh hokar hi rahega,
Tu kal ki fikar mein aaj ki hansi barbaad na kar.

Tumhe nazarandaaz karu, mujhme itna guroor kahan,
Tumhe nazar bhar ke dekhu, meri aankhon mein itna noor kahan.

Chhoti chhoti baaton par naraaz mat hua karo,
Galti ho jaane par maaf kar diya karo,
Naraaz tab hona jab hum rishta tod dein,
Aur aisa tab hoga jab hum duniya chhod dein.

Aaj likhne ka bada mann hai, magar kya likhoon,
Toote hue sapne likhoon ya bikhre hue khwaab likhoon,
Jo apne hokar bhi apne na rahe un rishton ka hisaab likhoon,
Ya phir un khamosh raaton ka, jinme khud se hi ki gayi baat-cheet likhoon.

Na jaane us shakhs ko kaisa hunar aata hai,
Raat hote hi aankhon mein utar jaata hai,
Main uske khayal se nikal kar kahan jaaun,
Wo meri soch ke har raaste pe nazar aata hai.

Aankhon se sawaal poochhna kisne sikhaaya tumko,
Muskuraakar maar dena kisne sikhaaya tumko,
Mann to karta hai tumhe saamne bithaakar rakhoon,
Usne itna pyaara kyun banaaya tumko.

Kuch toh reham kar zindagi, thoda sanwar jaane de,
Tera agla zakhm bhi seh lenge, pehle wala toh bhar jaane de.

Wo jaate jaate keh gaye hum sirf khwaab mein aayenge,
Humne kaha waada toh karo hum zindagi bhar so jaayenge.
